run_test_py_main: run the test.py module to generate optical flow predictions for Sintel or KITTI datasets
create_sintel_submission: create Sintel leaderboard submission with forward and backward optical flow predictions
create_kitti_submission: create KITTI leaderboard submission with forward and backward optical flow predictions
run_model_inference: run the unsamflow model on image pairs to produce forward and backward flow predictions
restore_model_from_ckpt: restore a trained model checkpoint and run inference on test dataset subsets
